task: Simulated heap (ae.gc) with coalescing allocator, mark-sweep GC and compaction
reasoning_summary: Wrote the layout, fit-policy and GC rules in TASK.md, then literal placement tests plus a seeded differential test against a naive reachability oracle with an invariant checker after every step. Two hand-computed expectations in my tests were wrong (an unrooted object, a miscounted tail extent); fixing the tests passed all 24. Mutants (best-fit tie rule, coalescing) failed 1 and 10 tests.
